title: All first-round picks are signed, except quarterbacks Fernando Mendoza and Ty Simpson

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: All first-round picks are signed, except quarterbacks Fernando Mendoza and Ty Simpson
sources.description: Before the 2011 Collective Bargaining Agreement created a rookie wage scale with slotted contracts based on selection position, the first overall pick would often sign a contract before the draft even began.
